name: review_obsidian_rook_structural_destroy
prompt: Weighty structural defeat of a pure black obsidian chess rook: first frames intact, then a sharp impact from upper-left makes the whole rook recoil and shake; magenta-red magical cracks spread from contact through battlements and base; split into five recognizable large structural chunks (battlement crown, left tower, right tower, central body, base) plus very few small chips; chunks separate outward with weight and begin falling; final frames consumed by a compact blue-white flash and dark obsidian dust. Keep classic rook identity, transparent background, restrained rather than huge explosion.
